capabilities: Visualize folders, notes and headings as nested circles
Show wiki-link connections with source dots and target arrows
Pan, zoom and preview notes on the map
Sync layouts across devices through vault files
extras: Layout sync is optional and uses a user-provided file-sync service; the map canvas stays dark even with a light theme; iPhone is unverified and Android support is planned.
problem: It is hard to see how folders, notes and headings nest together and how wiki-links connect them in one view.

relations.evidence: Windows ↔ iPadOS with Nutstore is the tested transport scope.

summary: Interactive map of folders, notes and headings as nested circles, with wiki-link connections and draggable layouts.
